description: This file defines the Reward model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to calculate reward point discounts during checkout (`getTotal`), confirm rewards when an order is finalized (`confirm`), and rollback rewards when an order is canceled or unconfirmed (`unconfirm`). The class interacts with session data, cart products, customer reward points, tax calculations, and reward management models.
external_methods: ext{	extbf{	exttt{	extless	extless lurp	extgreater	extgreater}}}

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model class managing customer reward points, including applying reward discounts during checkout, confirming reward point rewards, and removing rewards upon order cancellation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies reward point discounts to the cart totals, adjusting taxes accordingly, and updates the total and taxes variables.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms reward points for an order, adding reward points to the customer's account if conditions are met, based on the order info and total.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes reward points associated with a specific order, typically called when an order is canceled or reverted.
